message: When the lights go out, it can feel a bit unsettling at first, but I like to think of it as an opportunity for a cozy evening in! I’ve found that having a few candles, some snacks, and a good book can turn a blackout into a mini adventure. If you’re curious about how to prepare for power outages, there’s a handy resource that covers everything from keeping food safe to staying connected. What’s your favorite way to make the best of a blackout? 🌟
